azurerm_resource_group.name: azurerm_resource_group
azurerm_resource_group.description: Manages a Resource Group — the top-level container for Azure resources. Most other azurerm_* resources reference this via resource_group_name.

name.name: name
name.description: The Name which should be used for this Resource Group

location.name: location
location.description: The Azure Region where the Resource Group should exist (e.g., 'East US', 'eastus')

tags.name: tags
tags.description: A mapping of tags which should be assigned to the Resource Group

azurerm_virtual_network.name: azurerm_virtual_network
azurerm_virtual_network.description: Manages a virtual network. Equivalent to AWS VPC. Subnets attach to this via virtual_network_name.

name.name: name
name.description: The name of the virtual network

resource_group_name.name: resource_group_name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group in which to create the virtual network (typically azurerm_resource_group.X.name reference)

location.name: location
location.description: The location/region where the virtual network is created

address_space.name: address_space
address_space.description: The address space CIDRs used by the virtual network — list, NOT a single string

dns_servers.name: dns_servers
dns_servers.description: List of IP addresses of DNS servers

tags.name: tags
tags.description: A mapping of tags to assign to the resource

azurerm_subnet.name: azurerm_subnet
azurerm_subnet.description: Manages a subnet. Equivalent to AWS subnet but tied to azurerm_virtual_network. Note: address_prefixes is a LIST, not a single string.

resource_group_name.name: resource_group_name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group containing the subnet

virtual_network_name.name: virtual_network_name
virtual_network_name.description: The name of the virtual network to which to attach the subnet

address_prefixes.name: address_prefixes
address_prefixes.description: The address prefixes (CIDRs) for the subnet — list, NOT a single string

service_endpoints.name: service_endpoints
service_endpoints.description: Service endpoints to associate with the subnet (e.g., Microsoft.Storage, Microsoft.Sql)

azurerm_route_table.name: azurerm_route_table
azurerm_route_table.description: Contains rules for routing network traffic. Equivalent to AWS aws_route_table.

name.name: name
name.description: The name of the route table

resource_group_name.name: resource_group_name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group

location.name: location
location.description: The Azure Region where the route table exists

disable_bgp_route_propagation.name: disable_bgp_route_propagation
disable_bgp_route_propagation.description: Disable virtual network gateway route propagation

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags assigned to the route table

azurerm_public_ip.name: azurerm_public_ip
azurerm_public_ip.description: Manages a Public IP Address. Often used as the closest Azure analog when migrating from aws_internet_gateway (Azure has no IGW concept; routing to public IPs is implicit).

name.name: name
name.description: The name of the Public IP resource

resource_group_name.name: resource_group_name
resource_group_name.description: The name of the resource group

location.name: location
location.description: Azure Region where the public IP exists

azurerm_network_security_group.name: azurerm_network_security_group
azurerm_network_security_group.description: Manages a network security group containing security rules. Equivalent to AWS aws_security_group.

name.name: name
name.description: Name of the network security group

location.name: location
location.description: Azure region where the NSG exists

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags to assign to the resource

azurerm_subnet_route_table_association.name: azurerm_subnet_route_table_association
azurerm_subnet_route_table_association.description: Associates a subnet with a route table. The Azure equivalent of aws_route_table_association when the AWS source associates a subnet (not a gateway) with a route table.

subnet_id.name: subnet_id
subnet_id.description: The ID of the subnet (azurerm_subnet.X.id reference)

route_table_id.name: route_table_id
route_table_id.description: The ID of the route table (azurerm_route_table.X.id reference)
